poses.caption: Set your shoulders under the sled pads, keep your back supported and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform. Release the safety and straighten your legs without locking your knees.
Lower the sled under control until your thighs pass parallel, keeping your back against the pad and whole feet planted. Press smoothly back to the start.
